Yes, that error behavior feels right. When I put in "not a web address" and hit Save, nothing got saved — no half-made bookmark appeared — and instead I got a clear message telling me to enter a complete web address, with an example like `https://example.com` right there so I know what a good one looks like. And importantly, what I'd typed stayed in the box, so I can just fix it rather than retype from scratch.

That's exactly how I'd want a mistake handled: don't save junk, don't lose what I typed, and show me what "right" looks like without making me feel scolded. This one's good.
